name: source_network_contrast_window
motivation: Frozen global mammal exploratory results indicate that C-minus-R3 is attenuated both at greater external island isolation and for broader-distributed species. This future hypothesis is frozen only after those exploratory results and must not be back-projected as confirmatory.

ecological_model.core: internal source-network topology adds the most information when occupied insular sources are sufficiently numerous and heterogeneous to create structural contrast among targets
ecological_model.sparse_limit: strong external isolation depletes or truncates occupied source sets, making graph topology uniformly sparse or remote
ecological_model.saturated_limit: high species occupancy breadth fills many potential source islands, making graph topology more homogeneous and increasingly redundant with prevalence and direct/diffuse source context
ecological_model.prediction_shape: topological information should be strongest away from both sparse and saturated source-network limits; a unimodal relationship is a mechanistic possibility but is not assumed for the primary test

future_primary.required_new_system: independent response-sealed island occurrence system not used anywhere in Structural discovery or model development
future_primary.candidate_C: graph-path occupied-source continuity only beyond R3
future_primary.primary_1: overall held-out C-minus-R3 < 0 under block-weighted scoring
future_primary.primary_2: predeclared attenuation with external isolation: isolation-by-C increment direction positive on the C-minus-R3 scale
future_primary.primary_3: predeclared attenuation with occupancy breadth: breadth-by-C increment direction positive on the C-minus-R3 scale
future_primary.source_features: strict leave-heldout-block-out for training/pilot rows and no heldout response in confirmatory features

guardrails: do not select external-isolation thresholds from the new response
do not select occupancy-breadth thresholds from the new response
do not require or claim formal unimodality unless separately powered and preregistered before response
do not use GIFT v1.78 endpoint-available subset or global mammals as future confirmation
one independent system contributes one denominator unit regardless direction
